privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Information on the processing of your data

intro.title: Data Protection
intro.text: The protection of your personal data is of particular concern to us. We therefore process your data exclusively on the basis of legal regulations (GDPR).

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.text: Most data is collected because you provide it to us. This can be data that you enter in a contact form, for example.

usage.title: Use of Data
usage.text: We use your data exclusively to process your inquiries and to provide our services.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to information about your stored data, its origin and recipients as well as the purpose of data processing at any time. You also have the right to correction, blocking or deletion of this data.

contact.title: Contact for Data Protection Questions
contact.text: If you have any questions about data protection, you can contact us at any time.
